# DSH Studio v0.9.5

## Fixed and polished

- Preserved actionable updater errors when native cleanup also fails.
- Bounded GitHub release metadata requests and explained timeouts on the download page.
- Improved documentation keyboard navigation and landmark semantics.
- Added bilingual documentation search with shortcut guidance and an empty state.
- Added a platform support and verification matrix that separates automation from device acceptance.
- Clarified installer and project descriptions for runtime, profiles, plugin recovery and diagnostics.

## Verification

- Release quality, packaging, Rust, frontend, accessibility and documentation gates pass.
